preconditions.description: T is an integer between 1 and 150000 inclusive, representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(n.is_integer() and 2 <= n <= 300000 for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::] if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each test case starts with an integer n between 2 and 300000 inclusive, representing the number of monsters.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a_i) == 2 and a_i[0].is_integer() and a_i[1].is_integer() and 1 <= a_i[0] <= 10**12 and 1 <= a_i[1] <= 10**12 for a_i in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::] if line.strip() and not line.split()[0].isdigit()])
preconditions.description: For each monster, a_i and b_i are integers between 1 and 10^12 inclusive, representing health and explosion damage respectively.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line.is_integer() and output_line >= 0 for output_line in [int(line) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()])
postconditions.description: Each output line is a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of bullets required to kill all monsters in the corresponding test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_lines) == T for output_lines in [stdout.splitlines() if stdout.strip() else []])
postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= bullets <= sum(a_i for a_i in monster_data) for bullets, monster_data in zip([int(line) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::] if line.strip() and not line.split()[0].isdigit()]))
postconditions.description: The minimum bullets required for each test case is between 0 and the sum of all monster health values in that test case.

postconditions.expression: all(min_bullets == min_bullets_calculated for min_bullets, min_bullets_calculated in zip([int(line) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()], [calculate_min_bullets(monster_data) for monster_data in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::] if line.strip() and not line.split()[0].isdigit()]]))
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is the minimum number of bullets required to kill all monsters, calculated as the sum of health values minus the maximum possible explosion damage chain that can be triggered.
